subject.title: fix(cli): one-shot agent --local runs never export OTel diagnostics

question: Should `openclaw agent --local` and Gateway-to-embedded fallback be supported as first-class OTel-exporting processes that start and stop the diagnostics plugin service for each one-shot run, and should the independent `npm_execpath` build-environment change remain in this PR?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically plausible, but current Gateway-only service ownership does not by itself settle whether plugin services may be instantiated in short-lived CLI processes or whether the unrelated runner change belongs in the same landing decision.

options.title: Approve the scoped CLI lifecycle and split runner cleanup
options.body: Accept the OTel-only one-shot service contract, retain the bounded drain/stop behavior, and move the `npm_execpath` change to a separately scoped PR.

options.title: Keep the changes together
options.body: Accept both the CLI exporter lifecycle and the build-child environment sanitization as a single coordinated operational fix.

options.title: Keep diagnostics Gateway-only
options.body: Reject the new CLI plugin-service lifecycle and pursue a different observability mechanism for local embedded runs.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped CLI lifecycle and split runner cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the OTel-only one-shot service contract, retain the bounded drain/stop behavior, and move the `npm_execpath` change to a separately scoped PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The current member-authored branch defines and documents the proposed lifecycle, including the current-main fallback integration.
